title: ID0450521-DC/Si-D/SE-[Y2/S3 313586586002]-OCPP offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
OCPP offline. Tried to log in to the webpage locally but it wasn't reachable. Tried to factory reset and still the webpage was not reachable. Also tried to ssh in to it with command prompt but that was also not working.
Solution: Update charger to v8
